# Wick Chat
> Create instant, signup-free chat rooms. Share a link and start chatting with complete privacy.

## Core pages
- Home: /
- Create Room: /new
- Join Room: /join

## Features
- Anonymous: No signup required, no personal data stored
- Ephemeral: Rooms auto-delete after expiry
- Private: Real-time encrypted messaging

## Questions about Wick Chat
- Do I need an account? No. Wick Chat is completely anonymous.
- How long do rooms last? You choose — from 1 minute to 24 hours.
- Who can see my messages? Only people with the room code.
- Is Wick Chat free? Yes, completely free and open-source.
